paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for three different methods: Inconsistency-CE, Consistency-Bi +sampling, and Consistency-Bi +beam. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and follows a linear scale, with numeric values ranging from 2.5 to 12.5 at a regular tick mark interval of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale featuring dashed horizontal grid lines, with values ranging from 24 to 31 at a regular tick mark interval of 1. The data for "Inconsistency-CE" is represented by a blue dashed line with hollow circle markers. It demonstrates a steady upward trend across the x-axis, starting at an x-value of approximately 1.6 with a y-value of 24.1, and increasing to end at an x-value of roughly 11.1 and a y-value of 30.1. The data for "Consistency-Bi +sampling" is depicted as an orange dashed line with hollow upward-pointing triangle markers. This line also trends upward, beginning at roughly x=3.3 and y=27.8, rising continuously, and concluding at approximately x=13.0 and y=30.7. Finally, the data for "Consistency-Bi +beam" is shown as a green dashed line with hollow square markers. It exhibits an upward trajectory, starting at an x-value near 3.1 and a y-value of 27.5, and increasing to a final data point at an x-value of approximately 11.9 and a y-value of 30.9.
